rows.author: K091;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN “ADOPT-A-WILDLIFE SPECIES PROGRAM” AND PROVIDING INCENTIVES THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to identify and mitigate all possible threats to biodiversity/endangered species like urbanization, declining water quality, natural extinction, pollution, overexploitation, and climate change.
 
Intends to encourage the adoption of wildlife species by local communities under guidelines to be jointly promulgated by the DENR, the DA, and the DOF with active participation by the LGUs, NGOs, POs, civil society groups, and private individuals.
 
Refers biodiversity to the variety of living species on Earth, including plants, animals, bacteria and fungi - more specifically refers to all of the species in one region or ecosystem)
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2023-08-01

rows.author: K091;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TOTAL BAN ON THE IMPORTATION OF WASTES, PROVIDING MEANS FOR ITS ENFORCEMENT, APPROPRIATIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address contentious instances of shipments of illicit garbage into the nation, establishes a total ban on the importation of wastes, processed waste and its by-products.
Aims to uphold every Filipino's right to a healthy environment and prevent the worsening of our local trash problem and environmental pollution.  
Seeks to boldly convey to the foreign community that the Philippines is not a place where they can dump their garbage.
 
Tasks the DOTr, in coordination with DFA, the BOC, and the Maritime Industry Authority (MARINA), to take control of the seized vessel and its return to the port of origin of the contraband waste cargo; Proposes to establish an Environmental Protection Desk at every port of entry; and Provides for relevant penal provisions of environmental and customs law: 
a) Ecological Solid Waste Management, b) Phil. Clean Air Act, c) Phil. Clean Water Act, d) Toxic Substances and Hazardous and Nuclear Wastes Control Act, and e) Customs Modernization and Tariff Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 2023-08-01

rows.author: K091;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 5 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10752, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS “AN ACT FACILITATING THE ACQUISITION OF RIGHT-OF-WAY SITE OR LOCATION FOR NATIONAL GOVERNMENT INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSE”
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address the delays in the computation and especially of payment of just compensation as a primary cause of delay in accelerating the implementation of government projects.
Proposes to give property owners the choice of receiving compensation in the form of tax credits which is advantageous for the economy, the environment, etc. ; Encourages them to engage in a negotiated sale with the government instead of going through the drawn-out and arduous process of expropriation.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE NATIONAL POLICY ON ACCESS, AND BENEFIT-SHARING FROM THE UTILIZATION OF PHILIPPINE GENETIC RESOURCES AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to implement our commitment to the Nagoya Protocol; Defines several terms such as Biopiracy, Bioprospecting, Biotechnology, Clearing house, and Genetic resources, among others:
 Genetic material refers to any material of plant, animal, microbial or other origin containing functional units of heredity.

Proposes to create an Inter-Agency Committee on Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge to harmonize, integrate, enhance, implement, and monitor our compliance with treaty, statutory and regulatory provisions on access and benefit sharing (ABS) and utilization of Philippine genetic resources.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7925, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “PUBLIC TELECOMMUNICATIONS POLICY ACT OF THE PHILIPPINES,” BY REQUIRING PUBLIC TELECOMMUNICATIONS ENTITIES AND INTERNET SERVICE PROVIDES TO INSTITUTE A REFUND MECHANISM FOR SERVICE OUTAGES AND DISRUPTIONS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to require public telecommunication entities and internet service providers to provide a refund credit or bill adjustment on a prorated basis to customers who
experience internet service outage of at least twenty-four (24) hours within a month.
 
Proposes to add a new Section 20-A to Republic Act No. 7925, otherwise known as the “Public Telecommunications Policy Act of the Philippines”, to read as follows:
 
SECTION 2
 
“SEC. 20-A. REFUNDS FOR INTERNET AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS SERVICES OUTAGES AND INTERRUPTIONS.
 
. . .
 
(B) THE REFUND CREDIT GRANTED UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES MENTIONED ABOVE SHALL LIKEWISE BE GRANTED TO CUSTOMERS SUBSCRIBING TO A SERVICE ON A PREPAID BASIS.”
rows.status: Substituted by HB09021

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING DISCOUNTS ON CERTAIN TRANSACTIONS TO OVERSEAS FILIPINO WORKERS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8042, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "MIGRANT WORKERS AND OVERSEAS FILIPINOS ACT OF 1995," AS AMENDED
rows.abstract:
Proposes a minimum discount of 20% on several processing fees for necessary documents that OFWs must pay before their departure to alleviate their financial strain, and provide them immediate relief and enable them to retain more of their hard-earned money.
 
Proposes to add a new section labeled as Section 36-A after Section 36 of RA 8042, to read as follows:
 
SECTION 1.
 
“SEC. 36-A. DISCOUNTS. - THE OVERSEAS FILIPINO WORKERS ARE ENTITLED TO THE FOLLOWING DISCOUNTS:

 (A) AT LEAST 20% DISCOUNT ON THE PASSPORT ISSUANCE AND RENEWAL FEES;
 
(B) . . . ON CLEARANCE AND OTHER CERTIFICATION FEES . . . ;
 
(C) . . . ON ALL PHILIPPINE RELATED DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR OVERSEAS EMPLOYMENT; AND
 
(D) . . . ON PLACEMENT FEES.”

rows.abstract:
Promotes the concept of digitalization in agriculture as an appropriate technology to promote and fast-track digital platforms in the food value chain beneficial to both producers and consumers.

Mandates the Department of Agriculture to establish a synchronized agriculture information system to give the government access to accurate real-time agricultural information in order to enhance transparency in the food security system.

Provides a dynamic online computer database where information on the demand for specific agricultural and fisheries commodities is gathered and uploaded simultaneously with the production data from farmers in every barangay; a merger and synchronization of agricultural data from different sources into a cohesive database designed to facilitate linkages from place of origin or from farm to local and global markets.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 2023-08-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE PROTECTION OF GEOGRAPHICAL INDICATIONS FOR AGRICULTURAL OR NATURAL (UNPROCESSED OR WILD) PRODUCTS, PROCESSED PRODUCTS, WINES AND SPIRITS, OR ANY PRODUCTS OF HANDICRAFT OR INDUSTRY
rows.abstract:
Seeks to  safeguard our local producers´ superior quality of manufacturing and craftsmanship, and to protect consumers from disingenuous and substandard products that pose to be truly “Filipino-made.”
 
Seeks to ensure that products sold in the market were indeed produced, grown, or manufactured in the places they were said to have been produced, grown or manufactured.
 
Defines geographical indication as an identification of a good or product as originating in a territory, region, or locality, where a given quality, reputation, or other characteristic of the good is essentially attributable to its geographical origin and or human factors.


Defines Evocation of a geographical indication as a term, sign, or other labelling or packaging device that   presents a direct and clear link with the product  covered by a protected geographical indication  . . .
